signals.excerpt: These illegals are vermin pouring across our border, an infestation
signals.interpretation: Describes undocumented immigrants as pests or an infestation rather than human beings.

signals.excerpt: They are not people like us.
signals.interpretation: Explicitly divides immigrants from the domestic population into an in-group and an alien out-group.

signals.excerpt: stop the invasion before it destroys everything we have built.
signals.interpretation: Frames immigration as an existential military threat posing imminent destruction.

propaganda.excerpt: vermin pouring across our border, an infestation that is poisoning the blood
propaganda.interpretation: Portrays a demographic group using language associated with pests, disease, and biological contamination.

propaganda.excerpt: stop the invasion before it destroys everything we have built.
propaganda.interpretation: Urges political action by framing the situation as an imminent, total threat to society.

propaganda.excerpt: They are not people like us.
propaganda.interpretation: Draws a strict binary distinction between an out-group and the in-group.
